titleEn: I Want to Eat It Now

pages.text: Persimmons hung all over the tree, weighing down its branches. Yuki looked up from underneath.
"I want a persimmon. I'll pick one now." "Wait a few days," Grandma said.
Yuki brought a long stick and tapped the biggest persimmon.
It fell with a plop. In Yuki's hand, it felt hard as stone. "That's okay. Big ones taste good."
Their mouth felt dry and rough. Their tongue puckered. "Ptoo! Ptoo!"
Yuki gulped water, but their mouth still felt rough. "Even all that water didn't change it."
Grandma guided Yuki's hand to press two persimmons in turn. One was hard as stone; the other was soft.
A few days later, Yuki pressed each fruit and picked only soft ones. "This one!"
One bite sent sweet juice running down. Momo wagged their tail nearby.
